messages:
oliver: deploy-bot flagged a hard perf regression on v4.1.2 for /embeddings. p95 +60% and taily errors on some tenants. it auto-throttled to 15%. need ops decision: brief stabilize vs immediate rollback+pin. change window impact?

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout throttled to 15% for v4.1.2. Trigger: embeddings_p95_delta >= 55% over 5m. Suggested actions: hold 10m; targeted route-split to stable; manual rollback to v4.1.0. Autorevert: enabled by default.

ops-lead: i'm here. given magnitude, i'd prefer a targeted rollback for embeddings only and pin affected tenant buckets. minimize churn. also we should postpone any full-cluster change windows until we confirm.

hana: agree with ops-lead. i can run a tenant-scoped rollback and pin script in ~4m. will need the exact tenant list from monitoring (top 5 traffic tenants) and a rollback CLI snippet.

tess: drafting a concise customer note for impacted tenants: "We observed a performance regression in embeddings; we've temporarily reverted traffic for your requests and are investigating. No data impact." will prep expanded FAQ if we pin.

oliver: hana, use this rollback command pattern: ```/deploy rollback --service=embeddings --to v4.1.0 --scope tenant=<tenant-id> --reason "perf regression v4.1.2"``` also prepare a pin: ```/deploy pin --tenant <tenant-id> --version v4.1.0```

deploy-bot: [system] Autorevert scheduled in 12m unless suppressed. To disable: `/deploy autorevert disable --thread 4751234567`

ops-lead: disable autorevert for this thread. manual gate only.

deploy-bot: [system] Autorevert disabled by operator request for thread 4751234567. Autorevert window paused until 4751239999.

hana: pulling top 5 tenants now. will apply tenant-scoped rollback to those buckets and pin. staging rollback in dry-run mode first.

tess: sent draft to legal for quick review. tagging @legal for approval on phrasing.

legal: quick read: tone ok. recommend removing any mention of "no data impact" until postmortem validated. suggest: "We're investigating; we've applied a temporary mitigation to reduce impact."

oliver: acknowledged. tess, update note. hana, execute rollback once dry-run green, call it out here when done. ops-lead, coordinate support standby.

hana: dry-run looks good. executing tenant-scoped rollback to v4.1.0 for top 5 tenants now. pin commands queued.

hana: rollback executed for tenants: tenant-17, tenant-3, tenant-92, tenant-44, tenant-8. pins applied. verifying metrics...

hana: verification: p95 for those tenants dropped to within +8% of baseline. overall embeddings p95 improved to +22% after targeted rollback.

ops-lead: good outcome. plan: keep pins for 24h, monitor native rollout telemetry, then consider staged re-roll after perf fix. update release notes: short line about targeted rollback and investigation. tess, publish customer notes with legal wording.

oliver: thanks team. logging action items: 1) postmortem to diagnose quant/kernel change; 2) consider adding a preflight perf smoke for embeddings in deploy tests; 3) update rollback runbook with tenant-scoped examples. closing thread after docs and postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
